description_en: Configures Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) encryption for the database proxy endpoint of an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance
description_zh: 该接口用于设置RDS MySQL数据库代理连接地址的SSL加密
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-db-proxy-instance-ssl --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id 'rm-t4n3a****' --db-proxy-endpoint-id 'ta9um4****' --db-proxy-connect-string test123456.rwlb.rds.aliyuncs.com --db-proxy-ssl-enabled 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDbProxyInstanceSsl

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the region ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the proxy endpoint. You can call the DescribeDBProxyEndpoint operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 代理连接地址ID。可以通过接口DescribeDBProxyEndpoint查看
parameters.name: db_proxy_endpoint_id

parameters.help_en: The endpoint for which you want to enable Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) encryption
parameters.name: db_proxy_connect_string

parameters.help_en:
The operation to perform on Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) encryption. Valid values:
0: Disables Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) encryption.
1: Enables Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) encryption or modifies the Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) encryption endpoint.
2: Updates the certificate validity period.

Performing the preceding operations restarts the instance. Proceed with caution
parameters.help_zh:
对SSL加密执行的操作，取值：
0：关闭SSL加密
1：开启SSL加密或修改SSL加密地址
2：更新证书有效期

执行以上操作会重启实例，请谨慎操作
parameters.name: db_proxy_ssl_enabled

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter. No configuration is required
parameters.name: db_proxy_engine_type

schema.description_en: The details of the response parameters
